measurements.evidence_quote: The surface of the MPs was negatively charged, with the 0.2-μm beads having a more negative zeta potential (-42.7 ± 0.9 mV) than the 2.0-μm beads (-12.1 ± 0.6 mV). || The average hydrodynamic diameter and the zeta potential of the PS beads in Hoagland solution were determined by dynamic laser scattering (DLS) using a Malvern Zetasizer Nano-ZS90 (ZEN3590, UK).
